input.quote: 12.4 For eighteen months after termination Customer will not solicit or engage any person employed by Vendor at any time during the term.
input.rationale: § 12.4 binds only the Customer with an 18-month restriction that covers "any person employed by Vendor at any time during the term" — i.e., all Vendor personnel, not just those involved in the services — and bars us from "engag[ing]" them, which functions as a no-hire. There is no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out and no reciprocity. It also conflicts with § 12.3, which confirms we may hire any person responding to general recruitment and have made no no-hire commitment. Preferred position is no non-solicit on Customer, so we delete § 12.4; fallback (mutual, 12 months, personnel directly involved, with carve-outs and no no-hire) is offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Delete the Customer-only 18-month non-solicit/no-engage covering all Vendor employees (§ 12.4).
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted § 12.4: our position is that no non-solicitation restriction binds us, and a one-way 18-month bar on soliciting or engaging any Vendor employee also contradicts § 12.3, under which we make no no-hire commitment and may hire anyone responding to general recruitment. If a covenant is needed, we can accept a mutual one limited to personnel directly involved in the Services for 12 months from the end of their involvement, with carve-outs for general advertising and unsolicited approaches and no no-hire.
